key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to scan for listening ports (in seconds)

key.name: include-udp
key.description: Include UDP sockets in addition to TCP

key.name: only-exposed
key.description: Hide ports that are only bound to the loopback interface

key.name: watch-enabled
key.description: Restrict the menu list to ports within the watched ranges

key.name: watch-ranges
key.description: Port ranges (each "low-high") the menu list is restricted to when watching is enabled
